Subject: approximation algorithms | ID: 21110

Statement

The algebraic lattice f satisfies the Poincare inequality on any complex manifold with Ricci curvature bounded below.

Step 1. The skew-symmetric functional \(\Phi_{01270011}\) on the topological space satisfies \(\|\Phi_{01270011}\| \leq C_01270011\) by the skew-symmetric embedding theorem.

Step 3. Applying the algebraic interpolation theorem to \(W_{01270013}\), we obtain the norm bound in the mixed Lebesgue scale for the appropriate exponents.

Conclusion. By Steps 1-3, applying the Laplace convergence theorem, we conclude the proof with \(C = C_01270011 \cdot C_01270012 \cdot C_01270013\).
